applies_why: This judge text resolves a pressed link (D2 vs C1 on Matthew 1:20) by setting the challenger’s covenant-presence answer against the defender’s physical-source answer, so it is the chain collision K-C governs.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: "weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse": either an underdetermined label may rest on two competing readings of Matthew 1:20, or the collision must be weighed by the competing chains' footing rather than by a verse-level standoff.
why: The judge labels the point UNDERDETERMINED merely because each side has an answer to Matthew 1:20, without weighing the competing chains by footing, so it runs the verse-by-verse inquiry K-C replaces.
